تشقوا (form I)
# تَشُقُّوا (tašuqqū) /ta.ʃuq.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of شَقَّ (šaqqa)
# تُشَقُّوا (tušaqqū) /tu.ʃaq.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of شَقَّ (šaqqa)
